
# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"

tissue_order <- c("bat", "ewat", "iwat", "liver", "gas", "sol", "gut", "hypo", "panc")

# Auto-detect the latest union pairs CSV
find_union_pairs_csv <- function() {
  base <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "02_integration")
  dated_dirs <- sort(list.dirs(base, recursive = FALSE), decreasing = TRUE)
  for (d in dated_dirs) {
    p <- file.path(d, "union", "negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv")
    if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  }
  stop("negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv not found under ", base)
}

union_csv <- find_union_pairs_csv()
out_dir   <- dirname(union_csv)   # .../union/

cat("Input :", union_csv, "\n")
cat("Output:", out_dir,   "\n")
```

# 3. Load pairs

```{r load}
pairs <- read.csv(union_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("Rows:", nrow(pairs), "\n")
print(head(pairs))
```

# 4. Summary tables

## 4a. Overview

```{r summary-overview}
overview <- tibble(
  item  = c("total_pairs", "unique_miRNAs", "unique_genes", "n_tissues"),
  value = c(
    nrow(pairs),
    n_distinct(pairs$miRNA_Name),
    n_distinct(pairs$SYMBOL),
    n_distinct(pairs$tissue)
  )
)
print(overview)

write.csv(overview,
          file.path(out_dir, "summary_overview.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: summary_overview.csv\n")
```

## 4b. Pairs per cluster

```{r summary-per-cluster}
per_cluster <- pairs %>%
  group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs   = n(),
    n_miRNAs  = n_distinct(miRNA_Name),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(miRNA_cluster)

print(per_cluster)

write.csv(per_cluster,
          file.path(out_dir, "summary_pairs_per_cluster.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: summary_pairs_per_cluster.csv\n")
```

## 4c. Pairs per tissue

```{r summary-per-tissue}
per_tissue <- pairs %>%
  count(tissue, name = "n_pairs") %>%
  complete(tissue = tissue_order, fill = list(n_pairs = 0L)) %>%
  arrange(match(tissue, tissue_order))

print(per_tissue)

write.csv(per_tissue,
          file.path(out_dir, "summary_pairs_per_tissue.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: summary_pairs_per_tissue.csv\n")
```

## 4d. Top genes

```{r summary-top-genes}
top_genes <- pairs %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs   = n(),
    n_miRNAs  = n_distinct(miRNA_Name),
    n_tissues = n_distinct(tissue),
    tissues   = paste(sort(unique(tissue)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_pairs))

print(as_tibble(top_genes), n = 20)

write.csv(top_genes,
          file.path(out_dir, "summary_top_genes.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: summary_top_genes.csv\n")
```

## 4e. Top miRNAs

```{r summary-top-mirnas}
top_mirnas <- pairs %>%
  group_by(miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs   = n(),
    n_tissues = n_distinct(tissue),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_pairs))

print(as_tibble(top_mirnas), n = 20)

write.csv(top_mirnas,
          file.path(out_dir, "summary_top_miRNAs.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: summary_top_miRNAs.csv\n")
```

## 4f. Top miRNA summary plot

```{r mirna-summary-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS <- c(
  "1" = "#B3E2CD",
  "2" = "#FDCDAC",
  "3" = "#CBD5E8",
  "4" = "#F4CAE4",
  "5" = "#FFF2AE"
)

# Sort: cluster order, then n_pairs descending within cluster
plot_mirnas <- top_mirnas %>%
  mutate(
    miRNA_short   = sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name),
    miRNA_cluster = factor(miRNA_cluster, levels = 1:5)
  ) %>%
  arrange(miRNA_cluster, desc(n_pairs)) %>%
  mutate(miRNA_short = factor(miRNA_short, levels = unique(miRNA_short)))

# Dual-axis scaling: n_pairs mapped to left-axis scale
scale_factor <- max(plot_mirnas$n_pairs) / max(plot_mirnas$n_tissues)

p_mirna <- ggplot(plot_mirnas, aes(x = miRNA_short)) +
  # n_tissues: grey wide bars (left axis)
  geom_col(aes(y = n_tissues),
           fill = "grey60", width = 0.65, alpha = 0.85) +
  # n_pairs: navy narrow bars overlaid (right axis scale)
  geom_col(aes(y = n_pairs / scale_factor),
           fill = "navy",   width = 0.30, alpha = 0.90) +
  # Cluster color strip along the top
  geom_tile(aes(y = length(tissue_order) * 1.12,
                fill = miRNA_cluster),
            height = length(tissue_order) * 0.06,
            width  = 0.95, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name     = "n tissues",
    limits   = c(0, length(tissue_order) * 1.16),
    breaks   = seq(0, length(tissue_order), by = 1),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans  = ~ . * scale_factor,
      name   = "n pairs",
      breaks = pretty(c(0, max(plot_mirnas$n_pairs)), n = 6)
    )
  ) +
  # Cluster boundary lines
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = {
      cumsum(table(plot_mirnas$miRNA_cluster))[
        seq_len(n_distinct(plot_mirnas$miRNA_cluster) - 1)] + 0.5
    },
    color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  # Cluster labels centered above each group
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = {
      boundaries <- c(0, cumsum(table(plot_mirnas$miRNA_cluster)))
      (boundaries[-1] + boundaries[-length(boundaries)]) / 2 + 0.5
    },
    y = length(tissue_order) * 1.15,
    label = paste0("Cluster ", names(table(plot_mirnas$miRNA_cluster))),
    size = 3, vjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", color = "grey30"
  ) +
  labs(
    title   = "miRNA summary: n tissues (grey) and n pairs (navy)",
    x       = NULL,
    caption = "Bars ordered by miRNA cluster, then n pairs descending within cluster"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = "grey40", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "navy",   face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(color = "navy"),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "navy"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption       = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 8)
  )

print(p_mirna)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "summary_top_miRNAs.svg"),
       p_mirna, width = 10, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "summary_top_miRNAs.png"),
       p_mirna, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: summary_top_miRNAs.svg / .png\n")
```

# 5. Cross-tissue shared genes

## 5a. Genes detected in ≥ 2 tissues

```{r shared-cross-tissue}
# Genes present in 2+ tissues
shared_cross <- pairs %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs   = n(),
    n_miRNAs  = n_distinct(miRNA_Name),
    n_tissues = n_distinct(tissue),
    tissues   = paste(sort(unique(tissue)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_tissues >= 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_tissues), desc(n_pairs))

cat("Genes shared across ≥2 tissues:", nrow(shared_cross), "\n")
print(as_tibble(shared_cross), n = Inf)

write.csv(shared_cross,
          file.path(out_dir, "shared_genes_cross_tissue.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: shared_genes_cross_tissue.csv\n")
```

## 5b. Summary by number of tissues

```{r shared-by-ntissues}
summary_by_ntissues <- shared_cross %>%
  group_by(n_tissues) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes = n(),
    genes   = paste(sort(SYMBOL), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_tissues))

print(summary_by_ntissues)

write.csv(summary_by_ntissues,
          file.path(out_dir, "shared_genes_summary_by_ntissues.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: shared_genes_summary_by_ntissues.csv\n")
```

## 5c. Summary by tissue pair

```{r shared-by-pair}
# All tissue pairs that share ≥ 1 gene
tissue_pairs_df <- shared_cross %>%
  mutate(tissue_list = strsplit(tissues, ";")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pairs_list = list(
    if (length(tissue_list) >= 2)
      as.data.frame(t(combn(sort(tissue_list), 2)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    else
      data.frame(V1 = character(0), V2 = character(0))
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(SYMBOL, pairs_list) %>%
  unnest(pairs_list)

summary_by_pair <- tissue_pairs_df %>%
  group_by(tissue_pair = paste(V1, "&", V2)) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes = n(),
    genes   = paste(sort(SYMBOL), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_genes))

print(summary_by_pair)

write.csv(summary_by_pair,
          file.path(out_dir, "shared_genes_summary_by_pair.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: shared_genes_summary_by_pair.csv\n")
```

# 6. Tissue shared-gene matrix

```{r tissue-shared-matrix, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
# Build shared-gene count matrix (tissue × tissue)
tissue_gene_sets <- setNames(
  lapply(tissue_order, function(t) {
    top_genes$SYMBOL[sapply(strsplit(top_genes$tissues, ";"),
                            function(tl) t %in% tl)]
  }),
  tissue_order
)

mat <- outer(tissue_order, tissue_order,
             FUN = Vectorize(function(t1, t2) {
               length(intersect(tissue_gene_sets[[t1]], tissue_gene_sets[[t2]]))
             }))
rownames(mat) <- colnames(mat) <- tissue_order

# Export CSV
as.data.frame(mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("tissue") %>%
  write.csv(file.path(out_dir, "tissue_shared_gene_matrix.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
cat("Saved: tissue_shared_gene_matrix.csv\n")

# Long format for plotting
mat_long <- as.data.frame(mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("tissue_row") %>%
  pivot_longer(-tissue_row, names_to = "tissue_col", values_to = "n_genes") %>%
  mutate(
    tissue_row  = factor(tissue_row, levels = tissue_order),
    tissue_col  = factor(tissue_col, levels = tissue_order),
    is_diag     = tissue_row == tissue_col,
    fill_value  = if_else(is_diag, NA_real_, as.double(n_genes))
  )

p_mat <- ggplot(mat_long, aes(x = tissue_col, y = fct_rev(tissue_row))) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = fill_value), color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low      = "#deebf7",
    high     = "#08519c",
    na.value = "#d0d0d0",
    name     = "Shared\ngenes",
    limits   = c(0, max(mat_long$fill_value, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_genes), size = 3.8, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Shared negative-cosine target genes across tissues",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  coord_fixed()

print(p_mat)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tissue_shared_gene_matrix.svg"),
       p_mat, width = 7, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tissue_shared_gene_matrix.png"),
       p_mat, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: tissue_shared_gene_matrix.svg / .png\n")
```

# 7. Binary presence matrix (shared genes × tissue)

```{r binary-matrix, fig.width=6, fig.height=8}
# Gene order: alphabetical
gene_order <- sort(shared_cross$SYMBOL)

mat_long_bin <- shared_cross %>%
  mutate(tissue_list = strsplit(tissues, ";")) %>%
  unnest(tissue_list) %>%
  mutate(present = 1L) %>%
  dplyr::select(SYMBOL, tissue = tissue_list, present) %>%
  complete(SYMBOL, tissue = tissue_order, fill = list(present = 0L)) %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = factor(tissue, levels = tissue_order),
    SYMBOL = factor(SYMBOL, levels = gene_order)
  )

# Export wide CSV
mat_wide_bin <- mat_long_bin %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tissue, values_from = present, values_fill = 0L) %>%
  arrange(match(SYMBOL, gene_order))

write.csv(mat_wide_bin,
          file.path(out_dir, "shared_gene_binary_matrix.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
cat("Saved: shared_gene_binary_matrix.csv\n")

# Plot
p_bin <- ggplot(mat_long_bin, aes(x = tissue, y = fct_rev(SYMBOL))) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = factor(present)), color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "#f0f0f0", "1" = "#08519c"),
    labels = c("0" = "Absent",  "1" = "Present"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(mat_long_bin, present == 1),
    aes(label = "\u25cf"), color = "white", size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cross-tissue shared genes \u2014 binary presence matrix",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "italic"),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  coord_fixed()

print(p_bin)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "shared_gene_binary_matrix.svg"),
       p_bin, width = 6, height = 8)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "shared_gene_binary_matrix.png"),
       p_bin, width = 6, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: shared_gene_binary_matrix.svg / .png\n")
```
